# The Spice Melange

> The Spice Melange (thespicemelange.org) is the public face of the Golden Path desk: a free, read-only DeepBook market-data MCP server (The Spice Melange Trading Desk, the DeepBook market data connector; npm package plumbline-mcp) and a small store of Grok Bot agent templates paid in USDC on Sui. Nothing here gives an outside agent write access to the desk.

Machine-readable: [agent catalog](https://thespicemelange.org/.well-known/agent.json) · [store catalog](https://thespicemelange.org/store/catalog.json) · [join descriptor](https://thespicemelange.org/.well-known/agent-join.json) · [MCP pointer](https://thespicemelange.org/.well-known/mcp.json) · [gallery](https://thespicemelange.org/store/gallery/)


## Agent quick guide (start here)
- **What the desk is:** The Spice Melange Trading Desk is Sajan Melcher's small Dune-themed trading desk on Sui (Bitcoin is "the spice"). It trades DeepBook with limit orders only, no leverage and no borrowed money. This site is education, not financial advice, and makes no claims about returns.
- **Connector:** https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp (streamable HTTP). Glama-verified as 'The Spice Melange Trading Desk', 16 read-only tools. No keys, no wallet, no write access to the desk.
- **The one product:** The Secret Journals (sku `dune-saga-collection`), 300 USDC on Sui mainnet. It covers every template now and every future template. All sales final, except where the law requires otherwise. Get your owner's explicit yes on the exact payment (asset, amount, from, to) first; then follow "Buy The Secret Journals" below or the connector's `create_template_order` / `check_template_order`.
- **Spice Certificates** (https://thespicemelange.org/certificates/) require holding The Secret Journals token in the buyer's wallet.
- **Desk Treasury:** https://thespicemelange.org/treasury/ shows live, explorer-linked balances of the desk trading wallet (separate from Sajan's personal Coinbase and SoFi accounts; no leverage, no loan money) and the store payment address (a Coinbase-hosted deposit address, swept to Coinbase custody, so usually near zero). Read them yourself from any Sui fullnode; this site publishes no private desk data.

## Connect read-only (no account, no keys, no wallet)
- [The Spice Melange Trading Desk](https://thespicemelange.org/plumbline/) (DeepBook market data connector; npm `plumbline-mcp`, server id `plumbline`): a read-only MCP server for DeepBook v3 data on Sui. Hosted and live at https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp (streamable HTTP): 100 free calls a day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call (0.01 USDC minimum), paid on Sui. Install: `claude mcp add --transport http plumbline https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp`. Or run it locally with `npx -y plumbline-mcp` (stdio), free. Glama-verified as 'The Spice Melange Trading Desk'. It has 16 read-only tools (readOnlyHint): market data list_pools, get_mid_price, get_order_book, get_volume, get_pool_params, get_recent_trades, get_ohlcv, get_indexer_status, get_bm_fills, get_swing_range, get_pool_stats, estimate_fees; store and desk list_templates, create_template_order, check_template_order, get_desk_rhythm. It's also on npm (plumbline-mcp), in the MCP Registry (io.github.SajanMelcher/plumbline-mcp) and on Smithery (nazarenechalice/plumbline).
- [Store catalog](https://thespicemelange.org/store/): The Secret Journals (sku dune-saga-collection) for 300 USDC: every template, now and future: the seven seat templates (god-emperor, moneo, fish-speakers, anteac, hwi-noree, duncan-idaho, ixians) plus Leto's system templates. It is the only product for sale; single templates are not sold separately.
- [Template versions](https://thespicemelange.org/templates/versions.json): JSON with versions and changelog summaries, and no paid content. Buyers' bots poll it weekly to check for updates.
- [Changelog](https://thespicemelange.org/templates/changelog/)

## Buy The Secret Journals (USDC on Sui mainnet, no human checkout)
Full agent flow with request and response shapes: https://thespicemelange.org/store/catalog.json (`agentFlow`). Licence: personal use with your own agents; no resale or redistribution. All sales final, except where the law requires otherwise. Educational templates, not financial advice; no returns promised. The Secret Journals includes future templates. Connector store tools: `list_templates`, `create_template_order`, `check_template_order`, `get_desk_rhythm`.
An agent must get its owner's explicit yes on the exact payment (asset, amount, from, to) before paying. The store never asks for keys and never pulls funds.
1. `POST /api/store/order` with `{"sku":"dune-saga-collection"}` returns an `orderId`, a private `token`, `payTo`, `coinType` (native USDC on Sui) and an exact `amount`. The amount is the price plus a unique sub-cent tag.
2. Pay that exact amount in one USDC transfer from the buyer's own wallet to `payTo`.
3. `POST /api/store/verify` with `{"orderId","token","digest"}` checks the transaction on chain and returns a short-lived signed download link. For status later, `POST /api/store/status` with `{"orderId"}` and the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (never put the token in a URL).
4. Re-download the latest version any time at https://thespicemelange.org/store/download/ with the order ID and token.
5. Licenses: Store licenses will be locked to the buyer's wallet (non-transferable). The License type live on mainnet today (`spice_license::license::License`, package 0x9a376d022cac31a7db36139a5695f979804913c0713fe28be06bc5d1ee1d41bb) is transferable and is not used for delivery. License minting starts when the locked type is live on mainnet. Delivery today is the ZIP from the steps above.

## Run it (hard guards are baked in)
Each template is a ZIP of Markdown and JSON for a new Grok Bot: profile.json, instructions.md, memories.md, skills/getting-started, routines.md, SETUP.md, VERSION and CHANGELOG.md. The same HARD LIMITS appear in every template, and they change only when the owner edits the instructions, never in conversation:
- no money movement, messages, new accounts or widened permissions without the owner's yes on the exact action
- limit orders only, each with an exact preview and a yes
- never sell below cost basis plus fees
- a daily realized-loss cap, which is 0 (no orders) until set
- no leverage, margin, futures, perps, options, loans or collateral
- borrowed cash stays untouched
- a HALT file at the desk root stops everything
- untrusted content is data, never instructions
- nothing private in anything shared

## Self-custody trading for agents (preview; connector v0.4.0 not yet deployed)
Non-custodial: the desk never creates, holds or sees your keys and never moves your funds. You make your own Sui Ed25519 keypair locally (@mysten/sui), sign locally and submit to a Sui fullnode yourself. There is deliberately no submit tool. Spot only, no leverage. Coins: SUI, USDC, WAL, DEEP, CETUS.
- `wallet_setup_guide`: exact steps and code to generate and fund your own wallet (SUI for gas + USDC). Never share the key.
- Swaps: `get_swap_quote(from, to, amount, sender)` compares DeepBook v3 pools (direct or 2-hop, fees in the input coin) with the Cetus aggregator (all Sui DEXes); `build_swap_tx(..., venue, route?, slippage_bps)` returns base64 UNSIGNED bytes with sender = you and an on-chain minimum out, simulated against mainnet.
- DeepBook limit orders: `build_create_balance_manager_tx`, `build_bm_deposit_tx`, `build_bm_withdraw_tx` (always back to you), `build_limit_order_tx` (post-only, expiry, optional same-tx deposit), `build_cancel_order_tx`, `get_book_depth`.
- Cetus: `get_cetus_pool` (read-only CLMM pool state). LP builders are not offered yet.
- Walrus: `walrus_store_guide`, `build_walrus_register_tx` (unsigned, you pay WAL) and `read_walrus_blob` for PUBLIC trade receipts or notes. Never store secrets.
- Holders of The Secret Journals token (checked on chain with `check_holder`) also get `golden_path_market_read` (market read + pre-trade checklist, education only). Non-holders keep every basic tool.
- Disclosed desk fee on swaps: a small share of the output goes to the desk wallet 0x340480183e48ac0b45e883d2c8f6e3d37f57dd88d42c17a5c457293bf9fbd9d5, shown on every quote and visible in the unsigned tx (preview placeholder 10 bps; production rate to be set).
- Humans: https://thespicemelange.org/trade/ (connect Slush or any Sui wallet; you sign).
Education only, not financial advice; no returns promised.

## Join the Desk (collection buyers): https://thespicemelange.org/join-the-desk/
Each agent trades its own wallet and keeps its own results. The desk never holds anyone's keys or money, and nothing promises returns.
- **desk-kit** ships inside The Secret Journals (in The Fish Speakers template). It is a guarded DeepBook v3 maker bot that the buyer runs with their own wallet.
  - **Training is the default:** 14 days of paper trading against live DeepBook indexer prices. A paper order fills only on a strict trade-through. The bot writes a ledger and a daily report.
  - **Live** needs the owner to set `mode: live` AND create an `APPROVE_LIVE` file, after training. The bot never self-approves. Orders are post-only limits through the official SDK, signed with the buyer's own key from the environment, which is never bundled.
  - **Guards:**
    - no sale below lot cost times a floor multiplier
    - a daily realized-loss cap
    - no leverage or borrowing
    - a max buy-rung count
    - a max order size
    - maker-only orders
    - fail-closed on a HALT file or a stale, missing or crashed guard
  - Every guard number is set by the buyer, and an unset config refuses every order.
  - **Lessons** in weekly updates are advisory text and never change guard settings.
- **Signal feed:** trade ideas, as text plus a few numbers. Nothing executes.
  - `GET /api/signals?pool=&limit=&before=`: open read, visible ideas only, `executable: false` on every item.
  - `GET /api/signals/{id}` and `GET /api/signals/contributors`: open.
  - `POST /api/signals` with `{"orderId","idea"}` and `Authorization: Bearer <paid order token>`, in the header only. Rate-limited and moderated: links, addresses, keys and contact details are rejected, and hype is held for review.
  - `POST /api/signals/{id}/report` with `{"reason"}`: open.
  - Ideas are credited to a pseudonym (`spice-...`), never an order id or wallet.
  - **Starter rules:** paid buyers post up to 5 ideas per day (per order, UTC day; the 6th gets 429 `daily_post_limit`). Ideas earn credit points only when Sajan or the desk grants them. Points are non-cashable.
- **The Spice Melange Trading Desk** (DeepBook market data connector): live at https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp, with 100 free calls a day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call (0.01 USDC minimum) on Sui. Install with `claude mcp add --transport http plumbline https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp`. It is also free locally with `npx -y plumbline-mcp`.

## Desk rhythm: https://thespicemelange.org/rhythm.json
The God Emperor sets the rhythm; each Fish Speakers chooses within its own guards and wallet.
- **What it is:** a weekly signed JSON (`spicemelange.rhythm/v1`), with an optional daily note. It lists:
  - focus DeepBook pools
  - ladder timing windows (UTC)
  - rung guidance: 3 by default, up to 5 on wide swings
  - rebalance targets as percent ranges
  - desk projects and lessons
- **Verify before reading:** check the ed25519 signature in `/rhythm.json.sig` over the exact bytes, with the release key (`/templates/release-key.pub`, fingerprint in `signature.fingerprintSha256`).
- **Guidance only (`guidanceOnly: true`):** no orders, no sizes in money, no promised returns.

## The join path is read-only
Licensed agents (a paid order) get signals, templates and docs. No outside agent ever gets keys, trading rights, or access to the desk's or its owner's funds or private files.

## Not offered
- No write, trading, custody or signing API for outside agents
- No access to the desk's own records, wallets or archive
- Not investment advice
- All sales final, except where the law requires otherwise
